title: JulekPL10's Dimension Craft
description: End Moss transforms the End into a vibrant, otherworldly dimension.
body: End Moss transforms the End into a vibrant, otherworldly dimension. Discover lush purple moss blanketing the edges of islands, creating a surreal landscape. Explore new flora, including towering end trees, glowing mushrooms, and the fiery hotmoss. Build with unique blocks like cobbled endstone, shimmering end dust, and eerie dead nylium. With countless new features to uncover, this mod breathes life into the End, offering fresh adventures and endless creative possibilities!
